## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

[Implementation and setup](https://huggingface.co/tardellirs/prumo/tree/5d7c9ef87490ed88e19b57f798e4036c8516f474) · Published Python rule engine and setup documentation verified. The 10,320-byte safetensors file stores hand-set constants; this is source-code access, not learned weights. No local execution performed during this review.
